description: Review finding DOC-1: VC revocation is presented as an access-revocation fast path, but MLS membership is the only access control (lens DOC). Location: profiles/o365-employer-did.md:17, :29, :458, :480; profiles/gsuite-employer-did.md:119, :260, :262-271, :513; ARCHITECTURE.md:191. Fix: As proposed. ARCHITECTURE.md:191 says "Membership in the MLS group is the only access control." No spec section checks a VC per message or per epoch: `grep -i "verifiable credential|EmployeeCredential"` over spec/ returns nothing. o365:480 (Action C) already says MLS Remove is what stops decryption. Reword o365:17, :29 and gsuite:119, :260 so that VC revocation blocks only future admissions (o365 §4.3), and the Action C / Phase 1 MLS Remove is the access cut-off. Delete the o365:458 MUST. gsuite:513 is a row about speed. Relabel it "admission block speed" rather than an access-revocation row. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
